question: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio of 7 : 6. Eight years hence, the ratio of their ages will be 8 : 7. Find the present age of B.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio changes 7:6 → 8:7 after 8 years

Difference stays same ⇒ 1 part = 8 years

So present ratio parts = 7 and 6 ⇒ difference = 1 part = 8

Hence B = 6 × 8 = 48

**∴ Answer = 48 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Present ratio = 7 : 6

After 8 years ratio = 8 : 7

**Formula used:**

Let ages = 7x and 6x

**Calculation:**

⇒ (7x + 8) / (6x + 8) = 8 / 7

⇒ 7(7x + 8) = 8(6x + 8)

⇒ 49x + 56 = 48x + 64

⇒ 49x − 48x = 64 − 56

⇒ x = 8

⇒ Present age of B = 6x = 48

**∴ The correct answer is 48 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Difference Rule

Difference of ages remains constant over time.

Ratio Method

Assume ages as multiples of a common variable.

Equation Solving

Use cross multiplication to solve ratio equations.
